title: bryophyllum peltigerum
intro: Bryophyllum peltigerum, commonly known as the Kalanchoe pinnata, is a succulent plant species native to Madagascar. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments due to its multiple health benefits, including wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Bryophyllum peltigerum include stimulating tissue repair, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
